name: Coin Run
note: Collect coins using only rendered pixels. Seeded 10×10 world; fixed-horizon score.
description: Guide the cyan player around a grid and collect yellow coins. Each move tests visual localization and a short route to the next target.
media_credit: Daniel Tremer / GeneralGameBench
media_caption: Recorded evaluation frames; clip playback is illustrative, not a latency measurement.

name: Dodge Lanes
note: Avoid falling obstacles. Two local visual policies and controls are included.
description: Dodge falling red blocks by moving between lanes. Staying alive requires noticing approaching obstacles and choosing a safe position.
media_credit: Daniel Tremer / GeneralGameBench
media_caption: Recorded evaluation frames; clip playback is illustrative, not a latency measurement.

name: ViZDoom · eight scenarios
note: Basic, defend center, defend line, take cover, health gathering, corridor, home and prediction. These are eight scenarios of one game family.
description: First-person Doom tasks cover aiming, navigation, defense and survival. Eight scenarios share one game engine and present different control challenges.
media_credit: GeneralGameBench capture; Doom content by id Software; ViZDoom contributors
media_caption: Recorded evaluation frames; clip playback is illustrative, not a latency measurement.

name: SuperTuxKart
note: Strong next candidate: controlled tracks, lap timing, renderer capture and deterministic resets need an adapter.
description: Race karts through colorful tracks with drifting, obstacles and power-ups. The game also includes battle, soccer and collection modes.
media_credit: SuperTuxKart contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Luanti
note: Modern voxel engine. Pin one game/modpack and separate referee-only Lua events from agent pixels.
description: Explore, dig and build in voxel worlds created with the Luanti engine. Its community games range from open-ended survival to focused platforming tasks.
media_credit: Luanti / Minetest Game contributors
media_caption: Minetest Game example on the Luanti engine.

name: Veloren
note: Private test worlds are a promising route. Combat scoring and reproducible resets remain research work.
description: Explore a voxel fantasy world, fight creatures and discover settlements. Movement, combat and long journeys create varied visual challenges.
media_credit: Hrom / Veloren community
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Warzone 2100
note: Use offline skirmishes, fixed maps and native replay/result verification. Visual-control adapter required.
description: Direct a customizable army in a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game. Research, base building and positioning determine how battles unfold.
media_credit: Pumpkin Studios, Underdone Gaming, Warzone 2100 Project / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: 0 A.D.
note: Pin engine and map. Build an offline referee adapter; do not expose omniscient simulation data to the agent.
description: Build an ancient civilization, gather resources and lead armies into battle. Economy and military decisions compete for attention in real time.
media_credit: Wildfire Games / 0 A.D. contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: SuperTux
note: Local levels make reset, completion and survival scoring plausible. Adapter not implemented.
description: Run and jump through side-scrolling levels as Tux the penguin. Avoid enemies and hazards while exploring paths and collecting items.
media_credit: The SuperTux Team / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Mindustry
note: Open-source game with private scenarios. Score objectives externally; keep scripting and state APIs referee-only.
description: Build supply chains that feed factories and defensive turrets. Balancing production, logistics and enemy waves is central to survival.
media_credit: AnukenDev / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: OpenTTD
note: Fixed maps and scenario goals. Requires long-horizon scoring and a separate planning-oriented division.
description: Build a transport company using trains, roads, ships and aircraft. Profitable routes depend on network design, capacity and changing demand.
media_credit: OpenTTD / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: NetHack
note: NLE offers a research interface. Use rendered observations; terminal-symbol and state tracks must be separate.
description: Explore a dangerous dungeon filled with monsters, objects and uncertain consequences. Turn-based decisions reward careful resource use and planning.
media_credit: NetHack and NLE contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: MiniHack
note: NLE-based skill tasks. Archived upstream; installation/version compatibility needs validation.
description: Small NetHack-based worlds isolate skills such as navigation, tool use and combat. The tiles show compact problems with different goals.
media_credit: MiniHack / Meta research contributors
media_caption: Montage of MiniHack tasks from the project documentation.

name: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup
note: Open-source turn-based game. Tile capture and deterministic task/reset support need development.
description: Descend through a turn-based dungeon and search for the Orb of Zot. Character abilities, positioning and scarce resources shape each encounter.
image_alt: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup gameplay preview
media_credit: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
note: Long-horizon planning and survival candidate. Requires pinned saves, visual interface and auditable objectives.
description: Survive in a ruined world by scavenging, crafting and avoiding threats. Detailed inventories and changing needs make long-term decisions matter.
image_alt: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead gameplay preview
media_credit: Cataclysm: DDA contributors / Ultica artists
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Crafter
note: Achievement-based generalization tasks. An RGB adapter and achievement normalization remain to be implemented.
description: Gather resources, craft tools and survive in a small procedural world. Progress is measured through achievements rather than one final objective.
media_credit: Danijar Hafner / Crafter contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: MiniWorld
note: Lightweight navigation environments. RGB rendering and platform-specific graphics setup need validation.
description: Navigate simple three-dimensional rooms, paths and mazes from a first-person view. Compact tasks make spatial perception and movement easy to study.
media_credit: Farama Foundation / MiniWorld contributors
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Unity ML-Agents environments
note: Custom Unity games can offer rendered cameras and independent referees. SDK support does not make arbitrary Unity titles controllable.
description: A collection of Unity scenes explores balance, locomotion, navigation and team play. Each scene defines its own observations, actions and goals.
media_credit: Unity Technologies / ML-Agents contributors
media_caption: Soccer example from the ML-Agents environment collection.

name: Google Research Football
note: Controlled football tasks. Keep raw state-based agents in a separate track from rendered-pixel agents.
description: Control football players in a three-dimensional match simulation. Passing, positioning and shots combine quick control with team tactics.
media_credit: Google Research / Football contributors
media_caption: Football Academy example published by Google Research.

name: Minecraft
note: MineRL/Malmo are established research routes, with version and installation constraints. Requires a lawful game setup and adapter.
description: Explore a block-built world, gather materials and craft increasingly complex tools. Open-ended survival creates long sequences of dependent goals.
media_credit: MineRL demonstration; Minecraft by Mojang Studios
media_caption: MineRL gameplay example; no Minecraft benchmark has been run here.

name: StarCraft II
note: Official SC2 API and PySC2 provide a strong offline candidate. Feature layers and privileged state cannot enter the pixels-only track.
description: Build a base, gather resources and command armies in real-time battles. Strategy, scouting and precise unit control all affect the outcome.
media_credit: Blizzard Entertainment
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Rocket League / RocketSim
note: RLGym is a research route. Simulator and retail-game results must be distinct; visual capture and access constraints need validation.
description: Drive rocket-powered cars to knock a giant ball into the opposing goal. Steering, aerial movement and team positioning meet in fast matches.
media_credit: Psyonix LLC / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Factorio
note: Official Lua API can implement a trusted referee. Agents would receive screenshots only. Game license and deterministic scenario needed.
description: Design a factory that turns raw resources into increasingly complex products. Transport networks, power and expanding production form a large planning puzzle.
media_credit: Wube Software LTD. / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
note: Official REDmod exists. A repeatable offline benchmark is exploratory, requires licensed installs, hardware and task/referee work.
description: Explore Night City in a first-person action role-playing game. Missions combine navigation, dialogue, combat and different approaches to a goal.
media_credit: CD PROJEKT RED / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Morrowind / OpenMW
note: Open-source engine is a viable integration route; original game assets require separate rights. Scripted tasks and capture not implemented.
description: Explore Morrowind through the open-source OpenMW engine. Quests, dialogue, navigation and combat offer different kinds of decision making.
media_credit: OpenMW community; Morrowind assets by Bethesda Softworks
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Half-Life 2 / Source SDK
note: Source SDK offers an offline research path. Game assets and SDK terms remain separate; full adapter and validation needed.
description: Move through a first-person adventure with combat and physics puzzles. A gravity gun turns objects in the environment into tools and weapons.
media_credit: Valve / publisher-provided Steam screenshot
media_caption: Representative game preview; integration remains a research candidate.

name: Atari / Arcade Learning Environment
note: Large established benchmark family. ROM permissions and pixel/action parity must be checked per title; not integrated.
description: A collection of classic Atari games spans ball control, shooting and navigation. Simple-looking screens can demand precise timing and sustained control.
image_alt: Atari / Arcade Learning Environment gameplay preview
media_credit: Farama Foundation; Breakout by Atari
media_caption: Breakout example from the Arcade Learning Environment.

name: Stable-Retro library
note: Potential multi-console coverage. No copyrighted ROMs are bundled; verify each integration and its game assets.
description: An emulator-based collection connects classic console games to agent interfaces. Different titles bring platforming, racing, fighting and other control tasks.
media_credit: Farama Foundation; pictured games retain their respective copyrights
media_caption: Multi-game preview from Stable-Retro documentation.

name: PettingZoo environments
note: Good route to simultaneous multi-agent competition. RGB-only support and outcome definitions must be checked environment by environment.
description: A collection of cooperative and competitive multi-agent games. Agents may need to coordinate, anticipate opponents or share control of a task.
media_credit: Farama Foundation / PettingZoo contributors
media_caption: Pistonball example from the PettingZoo collection.
